metadata.description: Bookipi for AI agents — run a small business from chat

plugins.name: bookipi
plugins.description: Run your business from chat. Invoices and the whole invoice document family (estimates, credit notes, delivery notes, purchase orders), customers and payment history, expenses and receipt scanning, deals, AI-written proposals, eSign contracts, recorded meetings with transcripts and AI summaries, reports and dashboards, and your Bookipi website. Installs the Bookipi skill — presentation rules, operation routing, and 21 flow playbooks (morning brief, collections run, win a deal, quick quote, stalled-deal recovery, website review) — and connects the hosted Bookipi MCP connector, with the `bookipi` CLI as the other path to the same operations. Sign in with your Bookipi account; no API key to manage.
